# Lakhan Mandloi

> Co-founder of TAFT AI Technologies Private Limited (TAFT AI) and a forward deployed engineer based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. He embeds with teams, owns problems end-to-end across frontend, backend and DevOps, and ships them to production, using AI tools to move faster without dropping quality. Building products since 2015.

## Current work

- **Co-founder, TAFT AI Technologies Private Limited** (since June 2026): AI products and engineering that ships. Website: https://www.tafttech.ai
- **DevOps Engineer, REVIVE Healthcare Group** (since January 2025, contract, remote): sole DevOps engineer owning CI/CD, infrastructure, deployment and reliability across their SIP and e-commerce systems.

## Previous work

- **CLSA Technology & Services LLP** (2019–2023): Software Engineer, then Senior Software Engineer. Frontend and GraphQL work on the CITIC CLSA Forums web app and the CLSA corporate website.
- **Tekdi Technologies Pvt Ltd** (2015–2019): Webmaster, then Senior Frontend Developer. UI technical lead for Sunbird and DIKSHA (India's national education platform), the Sunbird documentation portal, the Artificers CSS library and the Tjbase Joomla template used on UIDAI's Aadhaar website.
